headline: FX gain lifts profit as margins soften, guidance raised

drivers.explanation: GAAP net income and diluted EPS rose sharply largely on a $163M favorable FX swing — a $17.2M gain vs a $146.1M loss a year ago, per the income statement. Core FFO, which excludes FX, fell y/y.
Growth was driven by non-same-store (acquired and newly developed) facilities, whose revenue grew 25.6% y/y, offsetting a 0.6% decline in Same Store revenue.

G&A rose to $44.4M from $25.7M on NSA merger transaction/integration costs, executive severance and CEO-transition costs, and corporate-transformation costs, all itemized in the Core FFO reconciliation.

Same Store direct costs grew 4.3% y/y (led by property taxes and marketing) against a 0.6% revenue decline, compressing Same Store NOI 2.2%; consolidated gross profit still rose slightly on non-same-store contribution.

summary_short: Revenue rose to $1,232.9M (+2.6% y/y) as non-same-store growth offset a Same Store revenue dip; diluted EPS jumped to $2.55 from $1.76, though the gain was mostly a currency swing — Core FFO per share fell to $4.17 from $4.28.
summary_long: Total revenue grew 2.6% y/y to $1,232.9M as non-same-store growth (+25.6%) offset a 0.6% Same Store revenue decline. Same Store NOI fell 2.2% y/y as cost growth (+4.3%, led by property taxes and marketing) outpaced revenue. Operating income fell 6.7% y/y on higher G&A from NSA merger integration, severance, and transformation costs. GAAP net income and diluted EPS ($2.55 vs $1.76) rose sharply, largely on a $163M favorable FX swing versus a year-ago loss — Core FFO per share, which excludes FX, fell 2.6% y/y to $4.17. Cash rose to $259.9M from $134.6M q/q. Public Storage raised full-year 2026 guidance for Same Store NOI growth, non-same-store NOI, and Core FFO per share, citing NSA merger and PS Canada acquisition accretion.
